scripts.coverage:rust: command -v cargo-llvm-cov >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'cargo-llvm-cov not installed; run: cargo install cargo-llvm-cov'; exit 1; } && cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --summary-only
scripts.coverage:html: command -v genhtml >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'genhtml not installed; install via: brew install lcov'; exit 1; } && bun run test:coverage && genhtml coverage/lcov.info -o coverage/html --quiet && echo 'Report: coverage/html/index.html'
scripts.coverage:rust:html: command -v cargo-llvm-cov >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'cargo-llvm-cov not installed; run: cargo install cargo-llvm-cov'; exit 1; } && cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --html && echo 'Report: src-tauri/target/llvm-cov/html/index.html'
scripts.coverage: bun run test:coverage && bun run coverage:rust
scripts.validate: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && biome check src && bun test && bun run build && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && git diff --exit-code src/lib/commands/generated
